Package theknife.obj.user

Class Restaurateur

java.lang.Object
theknife.obj.user.User
theknife.obj.user.Restaurateur
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class Restaurateur extends User
Represents a restaurateur user in the system. A restaurateur is a type of User who manages a list of restaurants.

This class extends the User class and adds a list of restaurants, allowing the restaurateur to manage their owned restaurants.

Author:
Damiano De Mutiis 761348 (CO), Matteo Porto Bonacci 761396 (CO), Matteo Monticone 761701 (CO), Mattia Tamburo 760743 (CO)
